emails.subject: Launching: Sponsoring Eugene Marathon

emails.body:
I think this is an amazing idea! We have just over 2 months to get this done. Can we please all have a meeting to properly launch and create a plan for this. Lets do {!launchmeeting = this:THU}. 
Everyone please block their calendars for this meeting.
Best, Ops
emails.subject: Launching: Sponsoring Eugene Marathon

emails.body:
Hi, 
I will be unable to attend the launch meeting since I will still be at the NYC location. Can we push the meeting to {this:FRI} past 1pm? 
Let me know,
CFO
emails.subject: Launch Meeting Conflict

emails.body:
Hi CFO, 
No worries at all, unfortunately we cannot push the meeting to Friday, we have the employee party that day. CEO will send you a meeting link by {+1d} so you can hop on remotely. 
Best, 
Ops
emails.subject: Launch Meeting Conflict

emails.body:
Hi team! 
Thanks for a great launch meeting! This is going to be a great sponsorship and event. Below is a recap of what we discussed about the event and next steps moving  forward. 
CFO: In charge of master budget and making sure team is supported financially.
Ops: Research the Sponsorship Tiers and send to CEO once complete to sign off on. 
Marketing Team: Once logistics are completed please put together a pitch deck for the team. We have our pitch to the race director on {!sponsorshippitch = dom:9,+1m} that the "Pitch Team" will run: CEO, COO and, VP of Marketing.
Thanks and let me know if anyone has any questions. Once we get these nailed down we can begin to plan our presence at the event.
Best, 
EA
emails.subject: Launch Meeting Recap

emails.body:
Hi, 
Can CFO please send me the master budget we have for this event? I need to know our max budget. Once we have this we can have a better idea of which sponsorship tier to select and move forward with the event. 
Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Race Sponsorship Budget & Goals

emails.body:
Yes I have attached the Master Budget Plan below. Let me know if you need anything else from me as of right now. CEO will need to sign off on the final sponsorship tier/budget you choose from.
Best, 
CFO
emails.subject: Race Sponsorship Budget & Goals

emails.body:
Hi CEO, COO & CFO
Below are the sponsorship options for the Eugene Marathon:
Gold Tier: Donate +15k - Name on Merch, Website, and Prime Event Pop Up Spot, Free Advertising Through the Eugene Marathon Marketing.
Silver Tier: Donate +8k - Name on Merch, Website, Prime Event Pop Up Spot.
Bronze Tier: Donate +3k - Name on Website and a Event Pop Up Spot
Keep in mind this is the sponsorship cost and does not include all other costs associated with making this happen. 
CEO please let me know which option we will go with before {!approval_of_tier_budget = dom:19,0m} and make sure it aligns with budget.  
Best, 
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Sponsorship Tiers

emails.body:
We are going to meet a week from today to discuss and have the final approval of the sponsorship tier and budget for this event. I'll send out the link by tonight! 
Thanks, 
Ops
emails.subject: Approval of Budget & Tier

emails.body:
Now that budget and tier is confirmed can the Marketing team please put together a pitch deck for the race director. We need this by{dom:30,0m} so that we have a week for the Pitch team to get prepared. 
Thanks, 
COO
emails.subject: Pitch Deck

emails.body: Yes lets schedule a meeting for July 2nd that preps the pitch team for this. VP of marketing will lead the briefing.
emails.subject: Pitch Deck

emails.body:
Pitch went amazing! 
We have secured our Gold Tier 
Great job to the VP of Marketing and CEO for helping us be well prepared. Now lets put all of our effort over the next month into getting the Event Pop Up good to go!
I expect all people involved to block their calendars for August 10th and being present at the event.
Best, 
COO
emails.subject: Approval of Event!
